status: labels for the 120 h secondary horizon of configs/sensor_failure_tuning_v4.json (draft); same protocol as sensor-failure-model-v2

connection_loss_gt2s.label: connection_loss
connection_loss_gt2s.note: duration > 2 s or open; timestamps have 1 s resolution, so > 2 s means >= 3 s

episode_filter_rule: an episode qualifies if the filter is null, it is open at data end, or date_diff('second', start_at, end_at) satisfies the filter

periods.excluded: 2021 and cutoffs whose 30-day lookback touches 2021 or starts before 2019-01-01

built_for: development months only (2019-01..2020-12, 2022-01..2024-12); calibration and holdout months are not labelled
